sources.entry: Collabora Online Development Edition - Collabora Online Development Edition (CODE) is a powerful LibreOffice-based online office that supports all major document, spreadsheet and presentation file formats, which you can integrate in your own infrastructure. (Source Code) MPL-2.0 C++

summary.name: Collabora Online Development Edition (CODE)
summary.one_liner: CODE is the free, self-hosted development build of Collabora Online, a LibreOffice-based browser office suite for editing word processing, spreadsheet, presentation and diagram files.
use_cases: Self-hosting a browser-based office suite for home use
Testing Collabora Online features before they reach the stable release
Editing Office documents inside Nextcloud, ownCloud, Seafile or HumHub
Running a document editor on a Raspberry Pi with Docker
Small team document collaboration on a private server
summary.what_it_does: CODE is the development version of Collabora Online, built on the Collabora Office (LibreOffice-based) core, with builds released about once a month. It edits word processing (.odt, .docx, .doc, .pdf, .rtf), spreadsheet (.ods, .xlsx, .xls, .xlsm, .csv) and presentation (.odp, .ppt, .pptx) files, plus diagram formats (.odg, .vsd, .vsdx). Real-time collaboration, pivot tables, charts, macros and form handling are listed as features. It can be deployed via Docker (collabora/code image on x86-64, ppc64 or arm64), native deb/rpm Linux packages, or a virtual appliance, and integrates with file sync platforms through WOPI, with guides for Nextcloud, ownCloud, Seafile, HumHub and GroupOffice. The page includes step-by-step setup instructions for these integrations.
notable: Rolling development build of Collabora Online with features released before the stable version
Runs from the collabora/code Docker image or native deb/rpm Linux packages
Integrates with Nextcloud, ownCloud, Seafile, HumHub and GroupOffice via WOPI
Source code is available and the project accepts contributions
caveats: Page states CODE is for testing, home use or small teams and not recommended for production environments
Examples on the page are for testing purposes only; a supported stable Collabora Online version is recommended for production
Default configuration in the Linux packages expects SSL certificates and requires a reverse proxy setup for normal use
